thread.document:
I used DeepSeek v3.2 to solve the written portions of HW8, where it performed quite well and one shotted almost all of the problems. 

One interesting point was that DeepSeek struggled significantly with Problem 1(c), where it repeatedly overlooked/ignored the parallel computation model needed for the solution. I provided 2 nudges to hint DeepSeek towards the right direction, and only after these prompts did DeepSeek converge to the correct big O solution. Through this example I saw that while DeepSeek can correct mistakes when guided, it is not as strong at independently identifying these issues.

Strengths:

Able to parse matrix expressions, SSM equations, multi-step derivations, and more complex sets of symbols

Consistently one shotted problems on the first attempt

Algebraic Reasoning was strong

Detailed explanations

Weaknesses:

Struggled a bit with 1c; repeatedly ignored cost of vector and matrix operations

Sometimes provided overly long chains of reasoning
